races.name: Join The Southwell Racecourse Corporate Club Handicap Chase

verdicts.rp: by Alistair Jones: In an unconvincing field a chance is taken on last year's winner BRAVETHEWAVES who now goes in blinkers.

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Nursery

verdicts.rp: by Paul Smith: This is trappy but LILYWHITE HART ran well at Southwell last month and can benefit from dropping to 6f. Pride's Queen is next best.

races.name: Dance Through The Decades Christmas Parties Novices' Handicap Chase

verdicts.rp: by Alistair Jones: Preference is for KASTELLION who ran quite well in a higher grade on his chase debut.

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

verdicts.rp: by Paul Smith: Uomo Valeroso and GREEN SPAIN both showed promise on debut and the selection could take a big step forward today.

races.name: 2027 Annual Badge At Tramore Racecourse Maiden Hurdle
races.going: Soft-heavy in places on hurdle course (inspection 8am)

verdicts.rp: by Dave Stephens: There was lots to like about FORTY FIFTY 's first run for this yard in the Triumph Hurdle and a repeat of that should suffice.

races.name: Winter Ladies Night Saturday 28th November Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)

verdicts.rp: by Chris Wilson: Dual bumper winner POPTON POINT has fitness to prove on her hurdling debut but she looked promising last term and might be the answer.

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery

verdicts.rp: by Paul Smith: Defiant Dream can go well once again but turf winner LAST DANDELION could still have a bigger run in her and is preferred.

races.name: New Years Day Discount Tickets Online Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.going: Soft-heavy in places on hurdle course (inspection 8am)

verdicts.rp: by Dave Stephens: The smart bumper performer EVEN THO is bred to get this trip and is hard to oppose on hurdling debut.

races.name: Winter Ladies Night Saturday 28th November Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)

verdicts.rp: by Chris Wilson: Dan Skelton's six-figure recruit MADE IN REUGNY made a promising hurdle debut in France last autumn and gets the nod.

races.name: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

verdicts.rp: by Alistair Jones: The vote goes to TRUSTINTIMES who ran okay on his belated Flat debut and has since won a good handicap hurdle.

races.name: Book A Table For New Years Day Mares Handicap Hurdle
races.going: Soft-heavy in places on hurdle course (inspection 8am)

verdicts.rp: by Dave Stephens: The C&D winner MISS LIA acts on soft ground and she was beaten a head in this last year off 1lb higher.

races.name: Festive Fixtures At Southwell Racecourse Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

verdicts.rp: by Chris Wilson: He has a modest record over hurdles but NOBODY TOLD ME looks interesting on his first start for champion trainer Dan Skelton.

races.name: ARC 1M Bonus Handicap

verdicts.rp: by Richard Austen: There are e-w cases for most of them but those to concentrate on may be REY DE LA BATALLA , Way To Dubai and Spirit Of Breeze.

races.name: Bill Halley Outstanding Contribution Award 2026 Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.going: Soft-heavy in places on hurdle course (inspection 8am)

verdicts.rp: by Dave Stephens: THE DUCKS WALK (nap) ran another fine race at Punchestown last time and he won his point-to-point on soft so should handle this ground.

races.name: Christmas Jumper Day Sunday 13th December Handicap Hurdle

verdicts.rp: by Chris Wilson: The vote goes to handicap debutant KA MATE DU BRIVET , who ran well in defeat in the spring when last seen.

races.name: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back Handicap (Div 1)

verdicts.rp: by Alistair Jones: Most of these find winning difficult but TWITCH has won two of his last three and there were excuses for the defeat.

races.name: 2027 Group Package Deals Online Beginners Chase
races.going: Soft-heavy in places on hurdle course (inspection 8am)

runners.horse: I C U In My Dreams

verdicts.rp: by Alan Sweetman: The form of the race in which KIMY was second here last month is persuasive enough to earn her the vote.

races.name: Book The Bistro In Seasons Restaurant Handicap Hurdle

verdicts.rp: by Richard Austen: In the early stages of their handicap careers, GIMARIAS and The Brave Guy top the list with their interesting steps up in trip.

races.name: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back Handicap (Div 2)

verdicts.rp: by Paul Smith: A trappy race in which DANDY KHAN can follow up her success here 12 months ago. Orange Emperor is feared most.

races.name: Ladies Cove Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.going: Soft-heavy in places on hurdle course (inspection 8am)

verdicts.rp: by Alan Sweetman: An extra 4lb may not be enough to prevent REVOLUT NED from adding to his recent Fairyhouse success.

races.name: Conferences And Events At Southwell Racecourse Handicap Hurdle

verdicts.rp: by Richard Austen: Wild Goose looks solid to go well but preference is for MANUELITO (nap) who made an encouraging return to action at Aintree.

races.name: AWC Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap

verdicts.rp: by Richard Austen: Most lack any solid claims but FAR FAR OUT (nap) and A Daughters Love are exceptions to that. Intsaar is a handicap newcomer.

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Ladies Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.going: Soft-heavy in places on hurdle course (inspection 8am)

verdicts.rp: by Alan Sweetman: Several of these have shown ability on the track. However, the vote goes to LADY AURORA who cost a six-figure sum after winning a point.

races.name: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Apprentice Handicap

verdicts.rp: by Harry March: Black Missile was only narrowly denied his first success last time but MEHMAR (nap) split two subsequent winners on his yard debut.

races.name: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

verdicts.rp: by Harry March: Flag Of Nations showed much more in a race won by PROSEWRITER at Southwell last month but the latter is selected to follow up.

races.name: All Weather Championship Is Back EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)

verdicts.rp: by Richard Austen: This is probably a three-horse race between ZAJAL , Manolin and Manitoba , who are selected in that order.

races.name: All Weather Championship Is Back EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)

verdicts.rp: by Richard Austen: Haldon Fire is not passed over lightly after his debut second but it's also hard to ignore seven-figure yearling purchase MODERNIST.

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap

verdicts.rp: by David Bellingham: Preference is for SILENT STRIKE who finished a close third over C&D last month and is much better drawn this time.

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Fillies' Handicap

verdicts.rp: by David Bellingham: The vote goes to dual C&D winner CHANTELLE despite again being drawn wider than ideal.

races.name: Midnite Built Different Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

verdicts.rp: by David Bellingham: The choice is QUEBELLA whose two AW runs resulted in a win here and a third at Southwell where she ran into trouble.

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap

verdicts.rp: by Richard Russell: It could be worth chancing 3yo TRULY GLAMOROUS . Christopher Mason's gelding improved on turf this year and is unexposed on this surface.
